subject: general
question: Which of the following is an autobiography of LK Advani?
solution:
The correct answer is __**My Country My Life**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **My Country My Life** is the autobiography of L. K. Advani, a senior leader of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and former Deputy Prime Minister of India.
 
• The book was published in **2008** and covers his journey in Indian politics, spanning over six decades.
 
• The autobiography provides an insider's view of the political landscape of India, including the rise of the BJP.
 
• The book is divided into five parts, each detailing different phases of Advani's life and career.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Exam Warriors**: Authored by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, this book is aimed at guiding students to deal with exam-related stress.
 
• **Wings of Fire**: An autobiography of Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam, former President of India and a renowned aerospace scientist.
 
• **Dare to Dream**: This book is co-authored by Kiran Bedi, India's first woman IPS officer, and serves as an inspirational work focusing on her life and career.
 
• **Autobiography**: A self-written account of the life of a person, providing personal insights and experiences.
 
• **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**: One of the two major political parties in India, founded in 1980 and known for its right-wing politics.
